thread:
incident-bot: PAGE: GPU pool exhaustion in us-west-2 (queue growth + autoscaler failing). Severity: P1. Affected routing: hosted-api-prod us-west-2, ~18% of requests throttled.

leo: Acked. Oncall me (leo). Pulling SLO dashboards now. @devon @tanvi you'll likely be needed for placement.

devon: I'm on. Quick summary: starting 10:12 UTC we saw queue depth jump from 120 -> 1.2k requests. Autoscaler issued scale-up, but API returned 403 quota error when provisioning new MIG nodes. Also scheduler logs show repeated "placement_failed: incompatible_mig_slab". Looks like mixing 1g/2g/4g MIG sizes caused binpack fragmentation; current pools have 27% stranded vGPU equivalents.

tanvi: Confirming from placement metrics: free GPU slices exist but not usable because there's no contiguous allocation for the 4g profiles. Autoscaler retries thrashing and then hits cloud quota limit (per-account GPU cores). Error snippet from autoscaler:
```
ERROR autoscaler/provisioner: provisioning failed: cloud API 403 QuotaExceeded (gpu-cores), attempted=32, available=8
ERROR scheduler: placement_failed: MIG-size-mismatch
```

sara: Customer impact: CS reported latency spikes for customers A, B, C on us-west-2. Telemetry shows 18% 95p latency increase, 12 downstream 429s. I'm opening a CS ticket and will message impacted accounts.

ops-bot: Created incident incident-2026-03-15-2876543210, paging oncall rotation leo -> devon.

leo: Plan of attack:
1) Throttle non-critical batch jobs to free vGPU slices.
2) Temporarily reduce preferred MIG size from 4g -> 2g for the affected pool to allow binpacking.
3) Manual emergency scale using reserved pools in us-east-1 as fallback for cross-region routing.
4) Contact cloud support to request temporary quota bump.

ben: I can start throttling background jobs. Which label to use? `job.priority=low`?

devon: Yes, run this on the scheduler:
```
./placement-tool scale-label --label job.priority=low --replicas 0 --region us-west-2
```
I'm preparing a plan to convert some nodes: drain, reprovision with mixed MIG config (smaller slices) and rejoin to pool. That should regain ~40 vGPU equivalents.

tanvi: Reprovisioning will take ~8-12 min per node. We should do it in waves to avoid extra capacity loss. I'll start with two nodes now.

leo: While that's happening, enable emergency cross-region fallback for routing to us-east-1 for non-SLA customers. Command:
```
redwood-router set-fallback --from us-west-2 --to us-east-1 --match "customer.plan!=enterprise"
```

sara: Notifying top impacted customers now (CS ticket #CS-4982). Will ask for permission to route to us-east-1 for soft failover.

ops-bot: Autoscaler attempt #12 failed with QuotaExceeded at 10:25 UTC. Manual reprovision in progress.

devon: Node drain logs (excerpt):
```
drain node-kw-03: evicting 28 tasks, reclaimed 12 vGPU
drain node-kw-07: evicting 33 tasks, reclaimed 8 vGPU
```
We reclaimed 20vGPU so far but still short of large-model slots.

leo: Update: triggered manual `placement-tool binpack --force` to squeeze pods into smaller slices, got additional 10 slots. Still ~18 slots short for peak.

tanvi: First two reprovisions finished, added 16 small-slice vGPU equivalents. Waiting on the next wave.

devon: Cloud support replied: can grant temporary +24 GPU cores if we provide business justification and ETA to release. I've opened the request, APPROVED by account admin. ETA 30min.

leo: Good. In parallel, Ben keep throttling low-priority jobs. Sara continue CS comms. Devon/tanvi continue reprovision waves.

cs-bot: Notified customers: A (agreed to soft-failover), B (asking for ETA), C (requested status updates every 15m).

ops-bot: Incident timeline event: emergency routing enabled at 10:32 UTC.

leo: Quick metrics now: queue depth down to 420, throttled % dropped to 6%, 95p latency trending down. Still monitoring.

ben: Low priority throttle complete across regions.

tanvi: All reprovision waves done, we added 42 vGPU equivalents total. Scheduler fragmentation metric now 6% stranded.

devon: Cloud quota +24 cores applied at 10:58 UTC. Autoscaler retried and provisioned 6 new nodes. Pool capacity back to normal.

leo: Impact summary for incident record:
- Root cause: Mixed MIG sizes and binpacking policy caused fragmentation; autoscaler blocked by cloud GPU core quota and API throttling, leading to queue growth and customer latency.
- Mitigation: Throttled low-priority jobs, temporary MIG size preference reduction to 2g, manual reprovision waves, emergency cross-region routing, temporary quota increase.
- Customer impact: P95 latency increased ~18% for ~35 minutes; some customers experienced transient 429s. No data loss.
- Time resolved: 10:58 UTC (autoscaler succeeded + manual reprovision finished)

sara: I'm drafting the customer incident update now.

leo: Next steps / action items:
- devon: evaluate autoscaler backoff and surface quota errors earlier (ticket INF-780).
- tanvi: add safer rolling reprovision playbook (ops-runbook-75).
- infra: propose default conservative MIG mix to reduce fragmentation (RFC-129).
- cs: finalize customer comms.

ben: thumbs up. Anything else?

leo: Nope. Thanks everyone. I'll handoff to devon for follow-up. devon, you're onpost for the next 8 hours.

devon: Onpost. Will follow through on INF-780 and coordinate the quota policy change.

ops-bot: Incident closed to active mitigation at 11:05 UTC. Postmortem assigned to devon. :white_check_mark:

sara: Adding link to CS ticket in postmortem when ready.

(reacts: :eyes: onpost note, :white_check_mark: closure)
